verbal_intervention.headline: Fed decision week opens as a no-win vote: appointee against patron - hike odds ~90% while Trump demands cuts and keeps the pressure on (calls, trade-threat rhetoric); ION: 'Fed must raise rates amid Trump, Bessent theatrics'
verbal_intervention.source: AInvest (Sep 12, 'no-win vote: a president's appointee against his patron') / CNBC (Sep 5, carried) / Reuters Dolan (Sep 8, carried) / ION Analytics (Sep 10, carried) / Motley Fool (Sep 11, carried) - carried, sharpened into decision week
verbal_intervention.summary: FOMC Sep 15-16 (t-2) opens with the independence collision at maximum tension: markets price ~85-90% (headline 90%) HIKE while the president demands cuts, has phoned the chair repeatedly, and has threatened trade consequences unless rates fall. A hike over the president's objection stresses independence inside an already-burning bond market; a fold risks unanchoring expectations. The 'no-win vote' frame is now mainstream commentary, not fringe.

verbal_intervention.headline: Pezeshkian ties Hormuz reopening to end of US blockade - explicit Iranian precondition placed on the de-escalation track
verbal_intervention.summary: Iran's president publicly conditioned Strait of Hormuz reopening on the US ending its naval blockade - the first explicit, named precondition on the de-escalation track. Converts vague 'diplomacy possible' language into a checkable demand, and raises the bar for Monday's Oman talks: a deal now runs through Washington, not just Tehran-GCC proximity.

verbal_intervention.headline: CARRIED THRESHOLD: record $99bn yen intervention confirmed UST-funded; Japan reserves BELOW $1 trillion first time in recent memory (~$95bn August burn; ~70% of reserves in USTs)
verbal_intervention.source: Bloomberg via Japan Times / Reuters / CryptoBriefing - carried, threshold standing
verbal_intervention.summary: Standing threshold from the prior cycle remains the structural fact of the yen thread: official-sector UST selling is a live channel feeding US bond stress, and the intervention war-chest question is formally live with reserves under $1T. BOJ decision t-5 (Sep 17-18) re-tests the chest.

verbal_intervention.headline: CARRIED: Bessent met Ueda and Katayama at G20, publicly pushed BOJ hikes - external pressure converted into scheduled action Sep 17-18
verbal_intervention.summary: US Treasury Secretary publicly pressed BOJ hikes at the G20; the hike is now sources-confirmed for Sep 17-18. Extraordinary external pressure on an independent central bank converted into a scheduled policy action - a sovereignty-stress marker standing one week ahead of the BOJ decision, five days after FOMC.

anonymous_leaks.headline: CARRIED: traders-say BOJ set to lift rates Sep 17-18 but offer few clues on terminal rate - sources say hike to 1.25% locked, guidance deliberately opaque
anonymous_leaks.source: Reuters (Sep 11, sources say) / Business Times / CNA carry
anonymous_leaks.summary: Anonymous BOJ-sourced reporting keeps the hike locked for Sep 17-18 with the committee planning minimal terminal-rate guidance - deliberate opacity one week after the Fed decides and with the yen near 7-month highs. Anonymous-sourced scheduling days after a foreign government publicly pushed the bank remains a sovereignty-stress marker.

anonymous_leaks.headline: NEW: BOJ watchers see FOLLOW-UP HIKE BY JANUARY after the September move - survey shows forecast acceleration, pace faster than previously expected
anonymous_leaks.summary: Economist survey consensus now anticipates the NEXT BOJ hike by January after the Sep 17-18 move - the tightening path is being repriced faster, compounding the Reuters 'terminal 1.75% faster than expected' reporting. For the carry-trade complex this shortens the horizon over which the unwind risk compounds.

anonymous_leaks.headline: CARRIED + EXTENDED: RBI intervention channel diversified - $8bn+ unload (bankers-say), streak extension (traders-say), FX-swap mop-up as support channel ($115bn surplus ops), ~$11bn diaspora-deposit bill; governor on record
anonymous_leaks.source: Reuters (Sep 7 $8bn; Sep 8 streak; Sep 10 FX-swaps mop-up) / Bloomberg (Sep 9 $115bn swaps; diaspora $11bn) / Reuters governor CNBC-TV18 (Sep 11) - carried
anonymous_leaks.summary: Reserve-drain defense of the rupee in the 95.79-95.80 record-low regime continues through diversified channels: outright FX sales, an intervention streak, and now FX-swap mop-ups (reducing a $115bn cash surplus) while an ~$11bn diaspora-deposit liability adds a forward outflow. Defense is institutionalized, not spot.

central_bank_communication.headline: FOMC t-2: hike odds consolidated ~90% (85-90% band) amid a STOCK RALLY and EASING YIELDS into the decision - risk assets pricing the hike as absorbed
central_bank_communication.source: finance.biggo (Sep 12 07:25Z, 90%) / Motley Fool (Sep 11, 85%) / market.news (odds soar) - carried from CPI hot core +0.3%
central_bank_communication.summary: Post-CPI, the September hike (Sep 15-16, t-2) is a ~90% base case - and unusually, equities are rallying and long-end yields easing INTO it. Markets treat the hike as absorbed news while the independence collision (vi-001) supplies the real tail risk. A hike with easing yields would mark the cycle's first 'hiked-with-relief' session; a hold would force violent repricing.

central_bank_communication.headline: ESCALATED NUMERIC: German yield hits 17-YEAR HIGH as traders up ECB follow-up bets - selloff deepened after ECB executed 25bp to 2.50% and flagged Iran-war inflation; additional tightening teed up
central_bank_communication.source: livemint (Sep 11, 17-year high) / Bloomberg (Sep 10, selloff deepens) / WSJ (Sep 10) / Scotiabank (Sep 10, 'tees up additional tightening') / tradingeconomics (Sep 11) - carried, numeric upgraded from 'highest since 2011'
central_bank_communication.summary: The euro area's bond repricing hardened a rung: German yields reached a 17-year high (escalating the prior 'highest since 2011' marker) and desks price a NEW ECB hiking cycle after the bank hiked into a supply shock while warning the Iran war is fuelling inflation. Hiking into a selloff without a fragmentation backstop keeps the periphery-spread risk live.

central_bank_communication.headline: CARRIED: BOJ to raise rates to 1.25% this month, reach terminal 1.75% FASTER than expected (Reuters); Kyodo sources: 25bp at Sept meeting
central_bank_communication.summary: The BOJ's scheduled action is double-sourced (Reuters+Kyodo): 25bp to 1.25% on Sep 17-18 with the terminal rate reached faster than markets previously priced. Combined with the Bloomberg follow-up-by-January survey (al-002), the pace dimension - not the direction - is where yen-thread risk is compounding.

central_bank_communication.headline: CARRIED STATIC: PBOC reins in rising yuan as weak domestic demand clouds outlook - appreciation-resistance stance stands
central_bank_communication.summary: Standing leg: China continues to slow the yuan's rally against a weak-domestic-demand backdrop - the appreciation-resistance posture that pairs with the recapitalization push (rc-001) and the credit-demand failure (rc-004). No fresh deterioration or improvement captured this cycle.

geopolitical_posture.headline: FIRST MEASURED FLOW IMPACT: Bab el-Mandeb ship traffic HALVES (~15 crossings/day Friday, Kpler) as Houthi coastal takeover holds; AFP formalizes 'take over strait vital to global shipping'
geopolitical_posture.source: The National (Sep 12 08:25Z, Kpler data) / AFP (Sep 12 02:29) / Al Jazeera (Sep 11) / Reuters (Sep 10) / CNN (Sep 10, Mocha) / Politico (second route at risk) - carried consolidation + NEW measurement
geopolitical_posture.summary: The full-coast consolidation logged last cycle now has a measured flow consequence: transits halved to ~15/day with war-risk premiums in force. Hormuz (contested, US-facilitated transits) + Bab el-Mandeb (halved) + Petroline (shut) = the triple energy choke is now quantified on two of three legs. Asian and European trade routes absorb the reroute cost.

geopolitical_posture.headline: POST-WINDOW CATCH: Iranian commercial ship struck in Strait of Hormuz, ONE DEAD (authorities); attribution unclear - first reported fatality aboard a commercial vessel in the strait this window
geopolitical_posture.source: Independent (Sep 13 ~07:31Z live page) / Al Arabiya (Sep 13) / RTE (Sep 13) / Al-Monitor (Sep 12-13, 'fans fears of threats to oil supplies') - post-06:00Z Sep 13 capture (late fire)
geopolitical_posture.summary: An Iranian commercial vessel was struck in Hormuz with one reported death - attribution not yet established (US-side, Iranian-side, or insurgent unclear). The fatality raises the accident-escalation temperature inside the most contested chokepoint regardless of attribution; watch UKMTO and follow-up wires.

geopolitical_posture.headline: DE-ESCALATION TRACK WITH HEADWIND: GCC-Iran-Iraq Oman talks confirmed Monday, but Trump 'sours on diplomacy'; Pakistan pressing both sides back to table
geopolitical_posture.source: Amwaj (Sep 11, 'as Trump sours on diplomacy') / The National (Sep 10, UN envoy on Pakistan mediation) - carried schedule + NEW headwind
geopolitical_posture.summary: Monday's Oman meeting remains the scheduled de-escalation catalyst, but the reporting now carries an explicit US-side headwind (Trump souring) plus a mediator track (Pakistan). Iran's explicit precondition (vi-002) further narrows the lane. Watch-only: scheduled catalyst, not executed tick.

geopolitical_posture.headline: SUSTAINED + FRAMING ESCALATION: Petroline (East-West, 1,200km, up to 7M bpd design / 4-5M bpd normal flow) REMAINS SHUT with injuries reported; 'Mideast oil supplies cornered' as the Hormuz escape route sits dark
geopolitical_posture.source: Türkiye Today (Sep 12, 'supplies cornered') / Heraldo USA (Sep 12, remains closed + injuries) / Anadolu explainer (Sep 12, 7M bpd bypass route) / AInvest (Sep 12, spare-capacity 'mispriced domino') - carried shutdown + NEW framing
geopolitical_posture.summary: Saudi's overland Hormuz bypass remains closed days after the Iraqi-origin drone attack, with no restart announced and injuries now reported. Analysis legs frame global spare capacity as the next mispriced domino. With Hormuz contested and Bab el-Mandeb halved, every redundancy around the Gulf is dark - the supply corner is structural, not episodic.

geopolitical_posture.headline: CARRIED DE-ESCALATION TICK: Hormuz escorted oil shipments RISING with US naval assistance; US-facilitated transits >10M bpd counter-narrative stands
geopolitical_posture.source: AP / Stars & Stripes (Sep 11, carried) / macro-event board (00:41Z) - carried
geopolitical_posture.summary: Standing counter-signal inside the blockade-management regime: US-facilitated escorted transits keep rising (>10M bpd claimed), partially normalizing flows even while the blockade regime persists. The tick keeps the middle_east_war thread two-sided: kinetic escalation up, escorted-flow normalization up.

supply_chain_disruption.headline: CARRIED + NUMERIC: US diesel ~$6.05/GAL record; TTF European gas ~EUR 81/MWh, +145% YoY, highest since 2022 into low-inventory winter; Commerzbank sees further highs on Hormuz LNG squeeze

supply_chain_disruption.headline: CARRIED: war-risk premiums + Cape/Good-Hope and Saudi reroutes (75% of affected barrels) extend supply distances around the Mandeb chokepoint
supply_chain_disruption.source: carried (prior-cycle wires; Saudi reroute 75% / selective blockade 'safe except Saudi vessels')

The cost lands in European and Asian landed-energy prices with a lag - the inflation channel keeps compounding while the chokepoint stays closed.

regulatory_change.headline: CARRIED: China's $54bn (300bn-yuan special bonds) recap of eight state banks/insurers formalized - biggest recapitalization push in two decades; SCMP analysts: 'more needed' to reignite credit demand

regulatory_change.summary: The recap is formal policy, but the analyst consensus holds it patches solvency, not demand - credit demand stays weak while state capital substitutes for private borrowing. Standing evidence for the china_collapse hand state (recap leg + credit-demand failure leg).

regulatory_change.headline: CARRIED EXECUTING: Iran doubled gasoline price for heaviest consumers (to $0.04/liter beyond subsidized quota) - rationing-style regulatory change driving strikes

regulatory_change.headline: Private-credit regulatory backdrop: FSB vulnerabilities report (May) + Senate letters (May) + Bessent 'monitoring meetings' standing; in-window: private credit's pricing power fades as banks regain ground
regulatory_change.source: FSB (May 2026) / Senate Banking (May 2026) / webandit (Sep 12, low-grade) - carried backdrop + marginal in-window marker
regulatory_change.summary: The regulatory perimeter around private credit remains watch-listed (FSB report, congressional letters, Treasury monitoring) while market structure shifts: borrowers pivot back to banks as pricing power fades. No new rulemaking this window; backdrop stays live ahead of any stress spiral.

regulatory_change.headline: CARRIED STATIC: China credit-demand failure stands - August loans below forecast vintage; PBOC 'new normal' framing; Commerzbank: credit softness may spur easing
regulatory_change.source: CNBC (Sep 7, carried) / Commerzbank via TMGM (Aug 12, carried) / Caixin (Jul 16, carried) - carried
regulatory_change.summary: Standing leg: credit demand remains structurally weak despite the recap (rc-001) - state capital patches banks while borrowers abstain. The demand-failure leg of the china_collapse hand state is unchanged this cycle.
